title: serveMcp
description: `lathe mcp`: one MCP tool per aggregate command and query, and the check, over stdio, started for the project folder by `plugin/scripts/mcp-server.mjs`.

title: fileManager
description: Reveals a data file or a product folder in the system's file manager (`shell.showItemInFolder`), for Reveal a record's data file and Reveal a product folder.

title: runGit
description: `runGit`: runs git with `spawn` and an argument array to read a record's history.

title: browserHistory
description: The only code that calls `window.history`: `state`, `push`, `replace`, `go`, `back` and `forward`, used by Open a page (`navigate`) and the tab set's history.

title: keepLinksOutside
description: `keepLinksOutside`, and the About window's links, through `shell.openExternal`. The About window's own links open through its window-open handler (`aboutLink`).

title: restart
description: The development watcher's Electron process: `start` and `restart` spawn Electron with LATHE_DESKTOP_DEV=1, and rebuild and restart it on a change under desktop/src.

title: pack
description: The desktop package's `pack` script and the build settings electron-builder reads: --mac --dir, the release folder, the staged node_modules, and publish set to null.

title: mergeDataFiles
description: `mergeDataFiles`, which `lathe merge-data` runs: reads the base, ours and theirs of one data file, merges them row by row with `mergeData` against the table's key, writes the result over ours, and returns each clash and each row that breaks its table's rules.

title: VoiceListener
description: Runs the speech helper (desktop/native/speech/main.swift, built to out/lathe-speech) while the window is in front and its page wants it, and checks each JSON line it writes before sending it to the page.
